item.title: Woodside town manager on leave after releasing whistleblower report against mayor, council members
item.description: Woodside Town Manager Jason Ledbetter was placed on paid administrative leave Thursday, after he released a 14-page whistleblower report alleging that the mayor and mayor pro tempore pressured him to delay housing projects. item.title: Retail theft prevention drives surge of police overtime
item.description: In part due to a recent push to combat retail theft, Palo Alto police officers clocked over $2.1 million in overtime in the first half of fiscal year 2026, according to a newly released analysis.
